description: Behavioral patterns detected from user interactions. Auto-managed by the learning engine. Patterns require 3+ observations to reach moderate confidence.

detectable_pattern_types.description: Which departments or tasks the user accesses at different times
detectable_pattern_types.example: Strategy work in mornings, operations reviews in afternoons

detectable_pattern_types.description: Relative frequency of department context usage

detectable_pattern_types.example: Often switches from strategy to product after competitive analysis

detectable_pattern_types.description: Preferred response formatting detected from user modifications
detectable_pattern_types.example: User consistently reformats tables into bullet lists

detectable_pattern_types.description: Preferred response length detected from user feedback
detectable_pattern_types.example: User frequently asks for shorter responses in operations context

detectable_pattern_types.description: Which skills are invoked most frequently
detectable_pattern_types.example: Meeting intelligence invoked 3x more than document lifecycle

detectable_pattern_types.description: Which connectors are preferred for similar tasks
detectable_pattern_types.example: Prefers Notion over Google Docs for meeting notes

detectable_pattern_types.description: How user responds to proactive suggestions
detectable_pattern_types.example: Always accepts morning briefing, usually dismisses meeting prep

detectable_pattern_types.description: Different interaction patterns on different platforms
detectable_pattern_types.example: Quick status checks on iOS, deep analysis on desktop

detectable_pattern_types.description: How user prefers to review content before finalizing
detectable_pattern_types.example: Always asks to see current state before making changes
